Name: Gilead, Father of Jephthah
Summary: Gilead is named only as the father of Jephthah the judge, whose other sons drove Jephthah out.
KeyStory: Gilead begat Jephthah, and Gilead's wife's sons thrust Jephthah out, saying he should have no inheritance in their father's house.
LifeLesson: A father's house can cast out its own son — and later beg him back.
